name: codex-orchestration
description: Parent-routed single-agent execution with previous-task continuity.

interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. Version 0.9.0 has the parent classify internally and immediately launch one Luna / Max, Terra / Max, or Sol / High agent in its first response, eliminating the separate classifier spawn and wait. For activation plus work, the acknowledgement is the only pre-launch text; already-active tasks launch without startup narration. The selected implementer still receives the complete rich handoff: full classification, immutable whole-chat bundle and revision, prior results, workspace dependencies, route data, inspection policy, and requested cross-task continuity. The child is created through the native collaboration-agent call, invoked directly as the next tool call, with its model lane in the task name. The launch never goes through a deferred/internal wrapper that returns a host nickname, and the child is never renamed afterward. The invariant routing contract is installed once per chat activation; later prompts receive only compact root turn state while the implementer continues to receive the complete canonical bundle. There are no supervisors, implementation checkpoints, or review loops. The selected agent interprets scope, performs the work, verifies it, completes any explicitly authorized release, and writes a complete final response with continuity, substantive current state, a legitimate next step when one exists, and a class, implementation, and root-route footer; there is no Recommendations or supervision section. Root locally repairs a missing report ending instead of requesting a report-correction agent turn. Startup Git synchronization is prohibited: implementation-plus-release work checks GitHub once only after implementation and verification, deployment-only work checks when its immediate release phase begins, and work without an authorized release performs no remote Git check. Authorized deployments trace the final diff to the smallest running service set, include release jobs only when required, and verify the exact pushed revision and live path. Only the final user-facing report uses slightly less technical language for a general reader; internal routing, implementation, verification, and agent communication keep their full technical detail. Nonvisual results are relayed verbatim from the selected agent, without a root condensation pass. For experience-dependent outcomes, root performs one terminal visual check with the existing visual contract. Previous-task continuity, quiet startup, premise-mismatch checks, and exact task bundles remain.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” for same-chat read-only, artifact, tweak, and build routing.
